note: Short text for the skill tags of crates/types (Source, Form, TimeTag, RangeTag, Target, Category, Purpose, Effect, Trigger). Missing ones show the code's own doc comment.

Source.Combat: Power from Strength: weapons and fists.

Target.Line: Every unit along a line through the target.

Category.Active: Used on your turn for action points.
Category.Reactive: Fires by itself when its trigger happens.
Category.Passive: Always on: an aura around its bearer.

Effect.Slow: The target gets fewer action points.
Effect.Stun: The target skips its next turn.
Effect.Freeze: The target skips its next turn.
Effect.Heal: Restores HP up to the maximum.
Effect.Resistance: More resistance to the skill's aspects.

Trigger.CritHit: When the bearer takes a critical hit.
Trigger.HpBelow: When the bearer's HP falls below a threshold.
Trigger.AllyHpBelow: When a nearby ally's HP falls below a threshold.
Trigger.Controlled: When the bearer is stunned or frozen.
Trigger.EnemyAdjacent: When an enemy steps next to the bearer.
